findings.title: Started collector can escape the shared lifecycle when pidfd acquisition fails
findings.evidence: Popen succeeds before collectorLaunches/identity are recorded and before pidfd_open. An injected pidfd failure reaches finally with child!=None, collector_fd=None, collector=None, collectorLaunches=0. The exact finally AST issues no stop and only waits for the shared remainder; the fake still-running child times out. The API could continue beyond the advertised watchdog bound. This is not a real collector run.
findings.relatedRace: The cleanup finally never reconciles target-createdump children again. A child created between the final pre-cleanup observation and collector termination can be omitted. Mere absence in that one observation must not prove complete child cleanup.
findings.requiredCorrection: Record successful Popen immediately, then establish ownership/handle. Reuse the existing exact unreaped-direct-child fallback when pidfd setup fails, with the single shared cleanup remainder and explicit UNKNOWN/retention if identity cannot be proved. Reconcile target-createdump identities during bounded cleanup; never signal the resumer or broaden to unrelated processes. Do not infer complete cleanup from an unobserved createdump.
findings.requiredProof: Exact-source no-process fault cases for pidfd/identity setup failure after Popen, direct-child fallback, late createdump observation, unresolved/reused ownership and shared deadline accounting.

findings.title: Final collector admission omits the already-published parent cancellation marker
findings.evidence: On an observer exception the parent writes own/capture/cancel and sends CANCEL, leaving the last atomic health image potentially fresh and ADMITTED. Python checks the marker on polling, but the final PowerShell guard checks only health.json. It can proceed before the next watchdog poll even though a positive cancellation file already exists.
findings.requiredCorrection: Include the explicit cancellation source in the final pre-API guard and preserve UNREACHED/no request on observed cancellation or unreadable/uncertain required state. Keep the remaining final-check-to-API race and continuous CapturePhase UNKNOWN explicit; do not claim that a file check makes cancellation atomic with WriteDump.
findings.requiredProof: A fresh otherwise-admissible health image plus the cancellation marker must refuse with zero API calls; healthy exact receipt without cancellation remains admissible. Run any CLR/PowerShell proof only after affected SOURCE permission.

findings.title: A known natural collector failure observed during cleanup loses native priority
findings.evidence: If an observer fault occurs before the next poll and the collector has naturally exited7, finally child.wait returns7 without any cleanup signal. Current code writes collector.cleanupExit=7 but leaves both nativeExit fields None. The unchanged FINALIZE therefore returns2. The exact-source fake reproduces this with a ready terminal pidfd and no signals.
findings.requiredCorrection: Before forced cleanup, capture any already-known natural terminal return into the native outcome. Preserve actual forced cleanup returns separately and retain raw return/signal semantics. Once natural nonzero is known, observer/persistence failures must not replace it; native0 with observer errors remains HOLD.
findings.requiredProof: Source-bound natural0/nonzero and forced-cleanup cases, including observer failure before poll and publication failure; prove known nonzero priority and native0 observer HOLD without native children.

findings.title: Mapper can assign a real source line to an IL offset outside the method body
findings.evidence: The mapper accepts any IL <=int.MaxValue, then takes the last visible sequence point whose offset is <=IL. For a valid bound MethodDef with a finite body, IL0x7fffffff satisfies the current check and can be attributed to the last source line despite not being in that body. Existing wrong-MVID/zero-token negatives do not exercise this case.
findings.requiredCorrection: Validate a usable managed method body and actual IL range before assigning a source position. Missing body or invalid/out-of-range IL must produce an explicit unmappable limitation, not a fabricated source line. Retain PE/PDB hash/MVID/CodeView checks and existing three proofs.
findings.requiredProof: Add a bounded out-of-body IL negative plus relevant absent/unmappable-body handling to the existing offline mapper proof; original valid method/position and negatives remain unchanged.
